master_scenes.text: PayPal just opened a huge door. New linked wallets for agents mean an AI agent can spend on your behalf, with approval on every purchase.
master_scenes.caption: PayPal linked wallets let AI agents spend on your behalf, with approval on every purchase.

master_scenes.text: Meet PayTable. One shared tabletop where you prompt at paytable to shop, split group bills, invoice overseas clients, and move real money.
master_scenes.caption: Meet PayTable: one shared tabletop to prompt @paytable and move real Sandbox funds.

master_scenes.text: Watch an agent source a studio monitor across three merchants, negotiate the price down to two hundred sixty five dollars, and pause right at the orange human gate.
master_scenes.caption: Channel3 catalog search + A2A quote negotiation ($310 to $265), paused at Needs Approval.

master_scenes.text: Nothing leaves your PayPal wallet until you click Approve. One tap signs a cryptographic mandate, captures the Sandbox order, and locks carrier tracking.
master_scenes.caption: One tap signs a SHA-256 mandate, captures PayPal Orders v2, and registers Shipment Tracking.

master_scenes.text: Switch presets in one click: scan a dinner receipt into PayPal QR shares, bill Berlin in euros with Pay Later, flag duplicate subscriptions, or pool neighborhood solar funds.
master_scenes.caption: All 5 PayPal tracks: QR Dinner Split, EUR Pay Later + Creator Split, Budget Shield, Solar Pool.

master_scenes.text: Every run reconciles live in AG Grid, while the Rust engine blocks overspend caps, catches card declines, and rejects duplicate replay keys.
master_scenes.caption: Live AG Grid v36 ledger, APIMatic + MCP contracts, and fail-closed Rust spend guardrails.

master_scenes.text: PayTable. Linked PayPal wallets for AI agents, with human approval on every purchase.
master_scenes.caption: PayTable · Linked PayPal Wallets for AI Agents · Open Source MIT
